constraints.description: Default penalty on unfunded calls: share forfeiture
constraints.conditions: After a default uncured for seven (7) Business Days

constraints.interpretation: Missing a call is costly (forfeiture of shares, plus commercially reasonable interest and other remedies), so the simulator treats calls as mandatory.
